name: Kyouizon～Natsu Natsu Natsu Natsu～
source:
Haruto is a transfer student at a new school and is struggling to fit in. One day, he is approached by a classmate named Toru, a boy with an elusive air about him.
Talking about the games they love, hanging out after school, sharing an umbrella on rainy days... The time they spend together, just the two of them, gradually begins to grow.
"How about we hang out every day during summer vacation?"
A youthful summer begins with that simple, casual promise.

But...
Somewhere along the way, a subtle sense of unease begins to creep into what should have been summer filled with joy.
translation:
转学来到新学校的阳翔迟迟无法融入周围的环境。某天，同班同学透主动向他搭了话——那是个浑身透着捉摸不透气息的少年。
畅聊彼此热爱的游戏、放学后结伴闲逛、在雨天共撑一把伞……只属于他们两人的独处时光一点点增多。
“暑假里，我们不如每天都出来玩吧？”
那句随口许下的简单约定，拉开了一段青春夏日的序幕。

然而……
不知从何时起，一丝微妙的违和与不安，正悄然渗入这个本该满溢欢愉的夏天。
